TopicPrompt: A while ago you mentioned another Knight... Connors?

TopicPrompt: What made you join the Brotherhood?

ResponseText: I'd rather not... ruin this. I just need a brief moment where I'm not a Paladin to a headstrong, self-righteous, mutinous Knight.

Dear lord, the facility's water line? That would explain the bodies out there... But why? They must have known this would happen.
Well done, Initiate! That was some impressive detective work.
No time to dwell on that. Initiate, let's look for a station where we can access the waterline. This is what we need to weaken the vines.
I thank ya'. I really do. Please, find my poor Cassie, will ya?

Well... The last known whereabouts of one of our caravans. They set up camp there, but come morning the entire place was abandoned.

What were we talking about...? Oh, right.
Just your run-of-the-mill illegal natural gas pipeline, courtesy of the fine people at the Bysshe Company.

And, wouldn't you know it, they may have had an ulterior motive.
We ferried a lot of people through these tunnels. Didn't want any of our former clients trying to use it.
Not for business reasons or anything... We just didn't want anyone else going missing down here.
I snooped around a bit when I first recommended the route to Joanna. There's some offices that were clearly being used as bunks for a while.
Not sure what happened to them. Almost looks like they just dropped dead on the spot... That's not a bad omen, is it?
Er... In a past life I used to work with these pencil pushing sociopaths in suits.
Well, not at this facility, but I was in-the-know about their various nefarious dealings in the region.
I'd appreciate if the job offers were saved for later. We're here on pressing business.
Yeah, okay.
I dunno. They're all over this region, though. Hard as hell to cut, and they grow like they hold a grudge.
Well, I know that I'm glad you killed it. If it found me first, you'd be talking to a pile of diced meat right now.
Thank you, Initiate. Ad Victoriam.
I imagine any shady operations they may have in play wouldn't be something so easy to stumble across.
Though, it's good to know you've had dealings with them. Maybe that will provide a foot in the door.
Great, take a seat.
Right, as I was saying.
Dear lord, what is that thing!?
Of course.
Okay, back to it. Where were we?
Sure thing.
You and your Paladin can learn a thing or two about subterfuge, darlin'. She needs to work a little harder to hide that high and mighty aura of hers.
I've made several attempts to contact the Blue Ridge Caravan Company, in hopes of trading supplies. They turned me down. Every time.
I understand that the Brotherhood can be an intimidating presence, and the West Virginia chapter didn't exactly leave behind a shining legacy...
But I think we've shown we have Appalachia's safety and security at heart. Yet, they remain unwilling to even speak. I find it suspicious.
During our travels, we found that a "caravan group" was just as often a cover for slavers and Raiders. A friendly guise for rolling through towns.
I didn't suspect Blue Ridge of such at first, but their repeated refusal to talk, Mr. Knapp's story, and this letter are simply too much to ignore.
Boo.

That's right. Fort Atlas is secure for the time being, and with Shin out of commission, I'd like to step in and do my part.

It led him to fall back on what he knows: rules and doctrine. He doesn't trust anyone else to help him see beyond that. Not like he trusted Alan.
And because of me... because of a call I made, we all lost him. I know Shin will never forgive me for it.

TopicPrompt: I wonder if things would have been different if he were here.
ResponseText: Almost certainly.

TopicPrompt: Seems like he was a great man.

Sometimes I think... no, I'm certain, that I was selected for this mission in order to remove my perspective and influence.
The Elders saw my pull and experience as a threat, and knew I would never align with their goals...
What better way to prevent my meddling than to send me packing on a cross country venture?
I often wonder... if they ever expected me to report in at all. To make it here alive... Joke's on them, I guess.
